transcript.user: Why is the term deposit the full bar? Why not use the total of everything as 100%?
transcript.content:
The total moves every time prices or your savings change, so if we measured against it, one part would always look short. Instead, the part furthest ahead for its age share sets the size, and the other parts' bars are worked out from it. Here, Safety is $14,000 at 35%, so a full bar for Traditional at 32.5% is $13,000, and for Crypto also $13,000.

This way nothing has to be sold: if prices move, the bars move too, and new money simply goes to whichever part is still short.
